white.name: Boomberry
white.effect: When the sum of boomberries in the cauldron go above 7, your cauldron explodes!

orange.name: Pumpkins
orange.effect: Orange tokens don't have any effect when placed in your cauldron. An orange 1 can never be upgraded to an orange 6.

1.effect: Draw 1/2/4 tokens from your bag. You can place one in your cauldron. Put the rest back.

2.effect: If your cauldron explodes within teh next 1/2/4 tokens, you still score victory points and earn money this round, but you don't get to roll the bonus die.

3.effect: If this token is placed on a ruby space, immediately take a ruby.

4.effect: Score 1/2/4 victory points immediately if this token is placed on a ruby space.

5.effect: If you have at least as many orange tokens in your cauldron as this token's value, immeditealy score 1/2/4 victory points.

6.effect: Look at this token's value: for every white 1 token within the last 1/2/4 chips you placed, take a ruby.

1.effect: If there are 1 or 2 orange tokens in your cauldron, move this token forwards 1 extra space. If there are 3 or more orange tokens, move this token forwards 2 extra spaces.

2.effect: Put this token aside. After you stop drawing this turn, or your cauldron explodes, you can either place it or save it for any future turn as your final token.

3.effect: If you placed a white token in your cauldron immediately before a red token, add the white one's value to the red one's movement.

4.effect: If you have a red token in your cauldron, each white 1 token moves 2 spaces instead. This extra movement doesn't count towards your cauldron exploding.

5.effect: Every red token you draw has the value of the highest red token you've drawn this round.

6.effect: Draw a token from your bag and put it aside. Place it any time this round, even after you stop or your cauldron explodes. Drawing a white token this way still counts towards your cauldron exploding and you MUST play this token sometime during this round.

1.effect: If the previous token you placed was white, you can put it back into your bag.

2.effect: Double the printed value of the next token you place for its movement value only.

3.effect: Your cauldron's explosion limit increases based on the number of yellow tokens placed. 1 token increases the limit to 8 and 3 or more tokens increases the limit to 9.

4.effect: The first yellow token you place moves 1 extra space. The second moves 2 extra spaces. The third moves 3 extra spaces. Fourth and after have no movement bonuses.

5.effect: Draw another token and add its value to this one's movement. Put the extra token back in your bag. If the drawn token is a locoweed, treat its value as 1.

6.effect: You can pay 1 ruby to move this token forward 3 extra spaces. You can only do this once per yellow token drawn.

2player.effect: If you drew the same number of black tokens as the other player, move your droplet marker 1 space forward. If you drew more black tokens than them, additionally take 1 ruby from the supply.

3player.effect: If you have more black tokens than ONE of your neighbours, move your droplet marker 1 space forward. If you have more than BOTH of your neighbours, additionally take 1 ruby from the supply.

5.effect: When you acquire this token, put it in the bag of the player to your left, then move your droplet forward a space. When testing your potion, take a ruby for every black token in their cauldron. That player takes the same amount of rubies, but only if a black token is one of the final two placed in their cauldron.

6.effect: The player whose black token is furthest ahead in the cauldron moves their droplet forward 1 space. The second furthest player gets 1 ruby. One player can win both bonuses if they have 2 or more black tokens. In the case of a tie, all tied players get the respective bonus.

1.effect: Take a ruby if this token is one of the final two placed in your cauldron. If the final two tokens you placed are green, get 2 rubies.

2.effect: Put a bonus token in your bag if this token is one of the final two placed in your cauldron. Put 2 if the final two tokens are both green. For a green 1, take an orange 1. For a green 2, choose either a blue or red 1. For a green 4, choose wither a yellow or purple 1.

3.effect: If your white tokens add up to exactly 7, add up the value of all green tokens in your cauldron and move your last token forward that many spaces.

4.effect: If this token is one of the final two placed in your cauldron, you can pay 1 ruby to move your droplet forward a space. If your final 2 tokens are green, you can pay 2 rubies to move your droplet forward 2 spaces.

5.effect: If this token is one of the final two placed in your cauldron, put aside any 1/2/4 value token on your cauldron and place it as your first token next round. If final 2 tokens are green, set aside 2 tokens. You decide in which order they're placed.

6.effect: Roll the bonus die if this token is one of the final two placed in your cauldron. Roll twice if the final two tokens are green.

1.effect: Receive one of these bonuses based on the number of purple tokens in your cauldron. If you have 1 purple token, score 1 victory point. If you have 2 purple tokens, score 1 victory point and take 1 ruby. If you have 3 or more purple tokens, score 2 victory points and move your droplet forward one space.

2.effect: You can return the purple tokens in your cauldron to the supply for the following bonuses: Return 1 purple token to take 1 black token, score 1 victory point and take 1 ruby. Return 2 purple tokens to take 1 green 1 token, 1 blue 2 token, score 3 victory points and move your droplet forward 1 space. Return 3 purple tokens to take 1 yellow 4 token, score 6 victory points, take 1 ruby and move your droplet forward 2 spaces.

3.effect: Each of your purple tokens score victory points based on which spaces they are placed in your cauldron. Below 10 scores 0 victory points. 10 and above score 1 victory point. 20 and above scores 2 victory points. 30 and above scores 3 victory points.

4.effect: Exchange a token from your cauldron for a higher value one of the same color and put it in your bag. If you have 1 purple token, you can return any 1 value token for a 2 value token. If you have 2 purple tokens, you can return any 2 value token for a 4 value token. If you have 3 purple tokens, you can return a 1 value token for a 4 value token.

5.effect: Add up the victory points shown on all spaces covered by your purple tokens. Buy ip to 2 different coloured tokens, up to this total point value. You can do this even if you've exploded.

6.effect: Look at the number value on the token you placed after this one: score that many victory points.

1.effect: Move this token however many spaces your rat marker is moved forward this round plus 1 (max 4).

2.effect: This token hsa the same ability, colour and value as the last non-white token you placed.

3.effect: Move this token 1 space. When you distill essences, you can move your essence marker forward an extra space for each locoweed in your cauldron.

4.effect: Move this token a number of spaces based on how many different coloured toekns are in your cauldron, including this one.

5.effect: Move 1 space. You can return a non-white token of your choice from the cauldron to your bag.

6.effect: Count up all th eprinted values on the white tokens in your sauldron. Move this token that many spaces, minimum 1 space and maximum 4 spaces.
